title: Banking, insurance, health & other services
quote: Insurance FDI cap raised to 100% by the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act, 2025

items.what: **Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act** (**17 December 2025**): FDI ==**100%**== (was 74%)

boxes.title: 2025 Act also
items: Amends Insurance Act 1938, LIC Act 1956, IRDA Act 1999
IRDAI vision: **Insurance for All by 2047**; premium **Rs 11.9 lakh crore** FY25

boxes.title: Insurance terms
head: Term
Meaning
rows: Pre-loss position, no profit; general insurance, **not life**
Shipowners' third-party liability; first sovereign P&I: **Bharat Maritime Insurance Pool**

boxes.title: Health services
items: Govt health spending ==**1.43% of GDP**== vs NHP 2017 target **2.5%**
**PM-JAY** (2018, **Rs 5 lakh**) + state schemes cover ~**80%** citizens; only **35%** used it
**Aarogyasri**: **1 April 2007**, **Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy** govt; AP coverage **70%** households

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Penetration/density ≠ insured per 100 people → =="none of these"== (APPSC 2017)
⚠ IRDAI is **not** a Gadgil Committee idea
Indemnity does not apply to **life insurance**
Foreign tourist spending in India = ==invisible export== of services
⚠ **1 October** = BSNL (2000) and 5G (2022); **80%** national vs **70%** AP coverage
